role: Trainee Laboratory Technician – Construction Materials Testing
relocation_line: I will relocate to Vasse for this role and can start three weeks after an offer.
cover_letter_text:
Hi,

My name's Marc. I graduated in February 2026 with an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, and I'd like to start as a trainee laboratory technician. You're taking on a trainee at the Vasse laboratory with training in soils, aggregates and concrete, and that's the kind of start I'm after.

In the diploma I studied the AS 1289 soil testing standards and kept technical records. On building and subdivision sites in the Philippines I did inspections and quality checks and wrote up the results. I have a Victorian driver's licence and a White Card.

I will relocate to Vasse for this role and can start three weeks after an offer. I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

questions.question: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
questions.answer: Subclass 485 Temporary Graduate visa with full working rights until December 2027.

questions.question: How many years' experience do you have as a laboratory technician?
